root_cause.text: The looping in `inode_switch_wbs_work_fn()` processes all items from `wb->switch_wbs_ctxs` and can drain the list entirely before the work function returns; this drops the wb reference held by the items, allowing the wb to be freed while the work is still pending, causing use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Because inode_switch_wbs_work_fn() loops when processing isw items, it can happen that wb->switch_work is pending while wb->switch_wbs_ctxs is empty. This is a problem because in that case wb can get freed (no isw items -> no wb reference) while the work is still pending causing use-after-free issues." The patch removes the `while (1)` loop and adds a `WARN_ON_ONCE(!list)` guard to ensure the work function always has at least one item to process.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The inode_switch_wbs_work_fn() function loops to drain the entire switch_wbs_ctxs llist, which can leave the list empty while the work item is still pending, allowing the backing device (wb) to be freed (since the isw items holding wb references are consumed) before the work completes, leading to a use-after-free when the work later accesses the freed wb.
